pillar_1_palm_agronomic.name: Palm Operational Plantation Agronomic Intelligence

data_quality.foliar_samples: 293 distinct block/year events (Boron sparse: 173 samples missing)
data_quality.soil_samples: 7 of 42 blocks sampled (16.7% coverage; 35 blocks unavailable)
data_quality.weather_data: Estate-wide NASA POWER station average (excluded from block risk)

pillar_1_palm_agronomic.role: Exclusive foundation for canonical screening risk scores and yield models.

pillar_2_rgb_drone.name: RGB Drone Aerial Survey Module
pillar_2_rgb_drone.scope: MOPAD Site 2 High-Resolution UAV Orthophotos (1024x1024 crops)
pillar_2_rgb_drone.mapping_method: Unavailable (Canvas pixel grid offsets only; no GPS or GIS boundaries)
pillar_2_rgb_drone.data_quality: High optical detection accuracy (mAP50=0.98), but lacking georeferencing to B001-B042.
pillar_2_rgb_drone.role: Visual demonstration and image-level crown detection. Does NOT modify block risk scores.

pillar_3_multispectral_uav.name: Multispectral UAV Canopy Vigour Module
pillar_3_multispectral_uav.mapping_method: Unavailable (German beech forest research benchmark; no plantation linkage)
pillar_3_multispectral_uav.sensor: MicaSense Altum (Blue 475nm, Green 560nm, Red 668nm, RedEdge 717nm, NIR 842nm)
pillar_3_multispectral_uav.data_quality: Calibrated reflectance. Verified NDVI and NDRE calculation capability.
pillar_3_multispectral_uav.role: Spectral index calculation demo. Marked DEMO ONLY / UNMATCHED. Zero influence on block risk.

canonical_risk_engine.nutrient_risk_requirement: At least 3 of 6 nutrients must be measured; otherwise component is unavailable.
canonical_risk_engine.dris_requirement: Available only when complete leaf nutrient panel allows DRIS calculation.
canonical_risk_engine.weather_policy: Station averages repeated identically across blocks; excluded from block risk score.
canonical_risk_engine.soil_policy: Observed soil indicators reported where sampled (7 blocks); reported as unavailable for remaining 35 blocks.
